analysis.title_zh: NVIDIA Cosmos3-H-Dreams：面向临床手术场景的交互式生成仿真
analysis.summary: 公告介绍了 Cosmos3-H-Dreams，将交互式生成仿真拓展到具有复杂视觉与操作流程的临床手术场景。原文以操作 Cadiere 抓钳、抓取并提起胆囊为例，描述生成场景的实时响应。此前的 Cosmos-H-Dreams 基于 Cosmos-Predict2.5，面向 dVRK 桌面缝合。此次内容适合关注手术机器人仿真与体内场景生成的研究者，但所给节选未提供量化验证或获取方式。
analysis.application: 建议：科研迁移可考虑探索手术机器人交互仿真、器械操作场景生成与操作流程研究；这些属于研究设想，并非官方已验证效果。官方节选介绍了临床手术生成仿真及实时响应场景，但未提供实验结果，不能据此认定其已提升训练效果、临床安全性或真实手术性能。
evidence: Today, we take the next step and introduce Cosmos3-H-Dreams, bringing interactive generative simulation to the visual and procedural complexity of clinical surgery with our most convincing in-body imagery to date.
Picture moving the Cadiere grasper, grasping the gallbladder, and lifting it, all within a generated surgical scene that responds in real time.
Our first Cosmos-H-Dreams release, built on Cosmos-Predict2.5, brought interactive generative simulation to dVRK tabletop suturing, a foundational proving ground for surgical robotics.
